_comment: Stained Glass collection. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed stained-glass-window`, then given a look each (three lines per look). Shared look in styles/_glass.py, one thin module per look.

readme.title: Stained Glass
readme.summary: Pokemon as leaded stained-glass windows, lit from behind.
looks: the body cut into irregular panes of coloured glass with dark lead between them and round every part, each pane coloured from the original's colour there

each line's glass: cathedral jewels (Totodile, Uxie, Hatenna), Tiffany ambers and greens (Seedot, Cacnea, Kricketot), rose-window blues and reds (Poliwag, Mudkip, Luvdisc), art-nouveau pastels (Cottonee, Solosis, Elgyem), grisaille grey with yellow stain (Grimer, Klefki, Arctozolt), kaleidoscope (Basculin, Hawlucha, Cyclizar)
the glass glows softly as if lit from behind (it shines in the dark); clear glowing eyes
shiny: gold came instead of lead, and the glass turned round the colour wheel
